name: Lighting and shadows
body: Dean (2026-11-16): flesh out the engine's rendering so it handles proper lighting and shadows, so a full 3D platformer can be built on it. Directional, point and spot lights; a light usable from Nyx game code; shadow maps with PCF and bias handling; a PBR-lite material; an ambient/sky term. Keep 60 fps on the platformer scene. Lights in the world editor as a separate PR. Everything documented (docs/renderer.md, a lighting and shadows guide, tutorial comments). Decisions: docs/decisions.md D-058 and D-059 (provisional, not yet reviewed by Dean).
